title: Difficult to use the app because of ads!
body:
A standard “scam app”, which tries to manipulate you and talk to your feelings and trying to get you to pay for a subscription even though the content and the app probably isn’t adding that much new in the future.

I deleted the app, when I tried to use, but couldn’t without getting 3 different “time limited” scam ads thrown in my face! That way of thinking and doing is the cancer of marketing! 

It is too easy these days selling poor products to people by lying, brainwahing, scamming, paying for good rank, use subscriptions for static content, etc.

author: 12368:kr!:

title: Free version extremely limited
body:
I like this app, it's gorgeous and easy to use - but are they really telling me I need to pay a frankly outrageous amount of money just to be able to add more than 5 tasks?! This limit to its most basic function is ridiculous and is nothing more than a way to a) make lots of money on something that should be free or at least not so limited, or b) chase off potential customers.

Had the price been significantly lower, or the number of freely available tasks been greater, I would happily have continued to use this app. But as it is not the case, I am uninstalling without a second thought. There are plenty more to-do lists out there!
